is a Power Apps suite backed by VBA and macro-enabled Excel tooling for UI-friendly cutover configuration and mapping.

Overview
This repository is intended to support business users who need a familiar Excel-based experience for maintaining configuration and mapping data while enabling a modern Power Platform experience for downstream consumption.

The solution combines:

Power Apps for a guided, UI-friendly configuration experience
Excel macro workbooks for structured data entry and controlled updates
VBA automation for compiling, validating, and transforming mapping data
Intended use
The suite is designed for scenarios where teams need to:

maintain cutover configuration in a controlled spreadsheet workflow
manage source-to-target mappings with a user-friendly interface
reduce manual editing of raw configuration files
prepare consistent inputs for Power Platform-based processes
Solution scope
The repository will hold assets for:

workbook-driven configuration capture
VBA/macros that compile workbook inputs into reusable mapping outputs
Power Apps-facing configuration and mapping artifacts
Status
This repository currently establishes the project definition and scope for the Power Apps, VBA, and Excel macro-based configuration suite.
